description: Classify an AI system's EU AI Act risk tier (unacceptable / high / limited / minimal) given its use cases, industry, and Annex III category context. Returns the tier, rationale, and humanReviewRequired flag. Use this before get_obligations if the risk tier is not known. IMPORTANT: This tool returns regulatory obligations, not verdicts. Never summarize results as "compliant" or "non-compliant" — always surface the obligations themselves and note that human review is required.

explicitUnacceptable.description: Set true if the system falls under EU AI Act Art. 5 prohibited uses.

name: classify_risk_tier
